function.name: basketball_player_stats_get
function.description: Get current statistics for a specified basketball player Unlike basketball_game_stats_get, which gets statistics from a basketball game, this gets current statistics for a basketball player.

stats_fields.description: List of statistical categories to be fetched, including points, assists, rebounds, minutes.

function.name: basketball_game_stats_get
function.description: Get the detailed statistical data from a specific basketball game Unlike basketball_player_stats_get, which gets current statistics for a basketball player, this gets statistics from a basketball game.

team1.description: One of the competing teams in the game.

team2.description: One of the competing teams in the game.

date.description: The date when the game occurred.

stats_fields.description: List of statistical categories to be fetched, including total points, total assists, total rebounds, turnovers. Default to empty list

function.name: basketball_team_stats_get
function.description: Get current statistics for a specific basketball team Unlike basketball_player_stats_get, which gets current statistics for a basketball player, this gets current statistics for a basketball team.

stats_fields.description: List of statistical categories to be fetched, including total points, total assists, total rebounds, win rate.
